s0–s2 correct; s3 «Дві хвилини — це час, який потрібно витримати» marked TRUE but anchor says «дві-три хвилини» → borderline. Reasoning (two minutes is part of the window) is defensible but the phrasing invites dispute; a teacher would sharpen to «дві-три хвилини».

findings: Honesty architecture validated: 0 hard-gate defects reached shipped content. Every hallucinated extractive item (2) and numeral-government issue (3) was held in rejected[]/review_required. All shipped UA is VESUM-clean and anchor-grounded → 0 reject-lang, 0 reject-fact.

NUMERAL-GATE FALSE POSITIVE (candidate private issue): «близько + двох-трьох + gen.pl noun» wrongly fails the ends_2_4 nominative-plural expectation (var-gemma held a correct statement). Over-holds correct content — conservative, not unsafe — but should be fixed for accuracy.

Rater-only defect classes gates cannot see (the value of §5 human rating): cloze distractor discrimination (near-synonym options), matchup gloss precision, wrong-sense synonyms, B1-appropriateness of abstract terms, borderline-TF phrasing.
